Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with a resulting wrist fracture. The mechanism of
the impact is consistent with the injury sustained, and the pattern of force described fits the fracture seen on imaging.
Over the course of care the patient attended 28 visits, which is a somewhat longer course than is typical for an
uncomplicated fracture of this type, though progress was documented at each stage of rehabilitation. Examination
findings are partly supportive of the injury, with localized tenderness, reduced grip strength, and limited range of
motion at the wrist, while several other tests returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the same area has been
reported or identified in the available history. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated
charges for the same services. Ongoing monitoring and home exercise instruction have been provided, and the
patient has been advised to return if symptoms worsen.
